## bijection_verdict
**PASS.** Policy-side notes (not KB verdicts): (1) each baseline rule restates the arithmetic of the base clause its overwrite retires (late fee; returned-payment fee), so the corpus states the same formula once as "no longer in force" and once as the computation document's standard method — faithful to the source; the retired notes point to "the current … basis", which a reader resolves through the factors. (2) The base billing-correction row ("payments dated on or before the period's last grace day that cover the period's rent") does not say whether a later-reversed payment still "covers"; the source leaves this open and the KB carries it as the source has it. First revision; no earlier revision.
